keyPoints: Ushma (heat) urja ka ek roop hai; temperature uski maap hai (degree Celsius me).
Ushma hamesha garam vastu se thandi vastu ki taraf behti hai.
Chalan (conduction): thos padarthon me ushma ka behna — jaise garam chamach ka handle garam ho jaana.
Samvahan (convection): drav ya gas me — garam paani halka hokar upar uthta hai.
Vikiran (radiation): bina kisi madhyam ke — suraj ki garmi isi se aati hai.
Oon jaise kapde ushma ke kuchalak (insulator) hain — sardi me sharir ko garam rakhte hain.
Dhaatu ushma ke suchalak (conductor) hain — isliye khana pakane ke bartan dhaatu ke bante hain.
